Tosafot on Bava Batra 126a:1:1.hebrew: ובמלוה שעמו פלגי - לא משום דקי"ל ממון המוטל בספק חולקין, דהא לא קי"ל כסומכוס, כדפרישית לעיל (בבא בתרא ד' לה. ד"ה ומ"ש); אלא תקנת חכמים היא הכא, ובמקום שמפורש בהדיא דחולקין:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 126a:1:1.english: "And regarding the debt that is with him, they divide" - [This is] not because we hold that "money whose ownership is in doubt is divided," for we do not follow the opinion of Sumchus, as I explained above (Bava Batra 35a, s.v. u'mah shenA); rather, it is a rabbinic enactment here, and in [other] places where it is explicitly stated that they divide.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 126a:3:1.hebrew: אבל דרכום לא - לפי' הקונט' דטעמא משום דקנאום בשינוי, קשיא: דהיכי פריך "מעיקרא ענבים והשתא חמרא"? הא איכא למ"ד בהגוזל קמא (ב"ק ד' צה.) שינוי במקומו עומד:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 126a:3:1.english: But if they trampled them, no - According to the explanation of the Kuntres (Rashi), that the reason is because [the other heirs] acquired them through a change [of form], this is difficult: For how can [the Gemara] object, "Originally it was grapes, and now it is wine"? There is, after all, one who holds, in the chapter Hagozel Kamma (Bava Kamma 95a), that a change [of form] remains [in the original owner's possession, i.e., the item is still considered as it was]:
